_README: HPC / Apptainer settings for the openWQ calibration setup report. Fill in the values below once; when this file is present, the interactive setup report pre-fills its 'if running on HPC / Apptainer' fields (Execution tab) from here. You can still edit any field in the browser. Lines starting with '_' are ignored. Keys mirror the form fields: hpc_user/hpc_host/hpc_base/sif_local + the SLURM directives.
